english.title: Permit use of apparatus in contravention of a notice under s. 55 knowing that notice is in force
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted apparatus to be used, knowing that a notice under section 55 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 was in force in respect of it and the use of the apparatus contravened the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58(1) and (2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 61 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 provides that references to apparatus include references to any form of electric line.
(ii) Section 105 of the Act makes special provisions for this offence in relation to ships and aircraft.
(iii) Section 106 of the Act applies where a person is convicted of this offence and the use continues after the conviction.
(iv) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(v) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(vi) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant permitted apparatus to be used, knowing that a notice under section 55 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 was in force in respect of it and the use of the apparatus contravened the notice.

other.penalty:
If the offence involves or consists in a contravention of a notice under section 55of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 in relation to apparatus the use of which is likely to cause undue interference with wireless telegraphy used for the purpose of a safety of life service; or for a purpose on which the safety of a person, or of a ship, aircraft or vehicle, may depend:- A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Otherwise:- A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Fixed Penalty charge of £100-00p (in force from 01/10/2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
